hints.title: Track both extremes
hints.body: A negative number can turn the smallest product into the largest one. Remember the minimum product of a stretch ending at the current position as well as the maximum.

hints.title: Stretches ending here
hints.body: Any optimal stretch ending at index `i` either starts at `i` or extends a stretch that ended at `i - 1`.

hints.title: Three candidates
hints.body: The product ending at `i` is one of `values[i]`, the previous maximum times `values[i]`, or the previous minimum times `values[i]`. Compute both the new maximum and the new minimum from those candidates before overwriting either one.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
highest = values[0]
lowest = values[0]
best = values[0]
for value in values[1:]:
    candidates = [value, highest * value, lowest * value]
    highest = max(candidates)
    lowest = min(candidates)
    best = max(best, highest)
return best
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
